subject: 2026-11-01-openai-daybreak-blue-session-data-training
text:
The error is in the brief's "note" field.
Brief says: "OpenAI denied using their inputs for training, and after backlash it promised a separate opt-out."
Source says: "Backlash was swift , and OpenAI followed up with a second email promising a separate opt-out." That backlash and opt-out concern the Daybreak Blue change. The Buckmaster-Alpöge case is separate: "OpenAI soon presented its own proof but denied using their inputs for training." (The Decoder, already the brief's source; both sentences are already in its evidence.)
Suggested fix: Tie the opt-out to the Daybreak Blue change, e.g. "After backlash, OpenAI sent a second email promising a separate opt-out. The change has researchers worried about a repeat of the Buckmaster-Alpöge case, in which mathematicians uploaded drafts to OpenAI's Codex and OpenAI denied using their inputs for training."
